form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: ENTIRELY HANDWRITTEN in blue ink over the modern v. 4.20 form. OFFICE RESOLVED FROM THE PAGE: the Office box reads 'COMMISSION C' - office_index was blank, so the filing's own field resolves it to the County Commission Seat C race; transcribed verbatim (medium confidence - abbreviated, no 'Utah County' prefix). Box A is a slashed-zero glyph - recorded as '0' at medium confidence. Boxes B, C and F are written '$2,000' with the cents as a superscript '00'; rendered as '2,000.00'. Balance at Close is written '-$172.48' - a NEGATIVE value, transcribed as printed. Handwritten '$' signs dropped per the transcription convention. Signature box EMPTY (unsigned as scanned, not redacted); Date box 5/14/2020; clerk stamp 'RECEIVED MAY 13 2020' predates the written date - recorded, not reconciled. The summary page's footer boxes (Name of Candidate, Date of Report, Page) and the cover's Date of Report / Page boxes were left blank by the filer.

notes: This filing is content-identical to key 2cb5aaaf (same handwritten 5/14/2020 withdrawal report, same figures, same clerk stamp) - the county published the same document twice under different filenames.

The filer booked the refund of Schedule A row 2's 500.00 contribution as an EXPENDITURE rather than netting it against the contribution side; transcribed as printed and not adjudicated. This is also why Box D (2,172.48) exceeds Box B (2,000.00) and the close balance is negative.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (2,000.00) on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (2000.00) and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' (2,000.00)
contributions.detail: 3 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 = 2,000.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal AND its printed Total Contributions Received AND the promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 2,000.00 (this is the filer's first and only report of the cycle, so period == year-to-date) and is NOT summed as an increment. Monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind give the same sum here: no row is marked in-kind and the form prints no in-kind line.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (2172.48) on the p4 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to Schedule B's printed 'Subtotal for this page' (2,172.48) and its printed 'Total Expenditures Made' (2,172.48)
expenditures.detail: 13 Schedule B rows sum to 647.20 + 15.32 + 21.27 + 36.48 + 32.13 + 1.00 + 6.37 + 10.70 + 284.99 + 17.02 + 200.00 + 400.00 + 500.00 = 2,172.48 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E YTD 2,172.48 is the cumulative and is never summed. TWO CELLS WERE SETTLED BY THIS CLOSURE AND THEN CONFIRMED BY CROP: row 3 reads 21.27 (a first full-page reading of '21.29' was +0.02 wrong; the 900 dpi value crop shows the filer's flat-topped 7, the same glyph as the 7 in row 1's '647'), and row 1 reads 647.20 (not 647.22 — the 900 dpi crop shows his open-oval 0). The closure is unique for the pair actually read: with 21.27 and 647.20 the side closes to the cent. Per addendum E1/F5 the Utah County filing fee was NOT used to corroborate row 1.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and it is the only convention available: no cell on either schedule carries an in-kind marker and the v. 4.20 form prints no separate in-kind line, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind are the identical sum. Both were tested; both close (2,000.00 / 2,172.48).

itemized.notes: STEVE WHITE, 2020, modern_boxAF rev 'v. 4.20', ENTIRELY HANDWRITTEN in blue ballpoint over the born-digital fillable blank. FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates'), p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page' LAST — the addendum-I3 shape, confirmed by content rather than by ordinal. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound into this filing: there is exactly ONE page carrying the summary labels (p4) and it carries figures in every box. Page-face candidate 'STEVE WHITE' agrees with the channel label; the page-face Office box reads 'COMMISSION C' while index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' — the same seat, and no seat was inferred. Report type: the filled radio is '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination'; 'Is this report an amendment?' is marked No. INTRA-DOCUMENT DATE DISCREPANCY, recorded and not adjudicated (addendum D6): the signature Date box reads 5/14/2020 while the clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads MAY 13 2020 and the county's filename says 05.15.20. Box A (balance at beginning) is a SLASHED ZERO — 0 under the zero-glyph ruling; the unlettered final box 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' prints '-$172.48' with the minus sign written outside the dollar sign, and the NEGATIVE IS REAL (2,000.00 - 2,172.48). SCHEDULE B ON THIS FORM HAS A REAL PURPOSE COLUMN (Date / Provider-Vendor / Purpose / Amount) and every one of the 13 rows fills it — captured per addendum I3. The Date/Name/Address columns were assigned by CONTENT as well as position (field-shift screen, CHUNK_BRIEF section 7): every date cell holds a date, every name cell a person or company, every address cell a redaction bar over a city/state/zip line, and on Schedule B every purpose cell holds a purpose — no inversion. All six row-index traps were screened: the first written entry is in band 1 on both schedules (crop-proved), no continuation line, no voided row, no banner line, nothing below the last printed rule, and no doubled band (both grids are uniform-pitch, and every band was accounted for by the exact closure).
